provenance.notes: Installed via Claude Code's official /plugin install discord@claude-plugins-official. This repo tracks provenance only; no files are copied. Plugin contents: an MCP server (server.ts on discord.js, run under Bun via the plugin's own .mcp.json) plus skills configure and access. Note the upstream path is external_plugins/discord, not plugins/discord like the other tracked plugins. Bot token and access state live in ~/.claude/channels/discord/, which this repo does not manage.
